guideSemantics.timestampControl: Time ranges allocate pacing and exact time points improve alignment; they are not a frame-accurate edit guarantee.
guideSemantics.extensionPreservation: Preserve the source and match its boundary state, but review the join; generated continuation and boundary frames are not guaranteed pixel-identical.
guideSemantics.negativeInstructions: Explicit forbidden items improve reliability but remain probabilistic and require review.
guideSemantics.identityStability: Multi-character consistency is improved, not self-approving; identity and count still require visual review.
guideSemantics.longVideoRoute: The 5-180 second mode is a Dreamina beta product capability, not a qualified Studio API route.
guideSemantics.audioOnly: Dreamina product guidance describes audio-only creation; the current BytePlus Seedance 2.0 API still requires at least one image or video reference.
guideSemantics.cleanOutput: Dreamina advertises cleaner 4K output; the executable provider contract remains the authority for resolution and every render still requires QC.
guideSemantics.watermarkPolicy: The Studio never uses generative watermark removal as a production shortcut; source footage must be owned or licensed and delivered clean.
